headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.7 on an otherwise quiet day
body: A quiet day with one story. Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7, its most capable generally available model, with stronger coding and agent skills. A new top model pushes Capability Velocity up a notch, which lifts every ending that needs powerful AI, such as Enslaved God and Descendants, and nudges Reversion down. All moves were tiny. Horizon Balance sits at +3.40.
movers_note: Every move was under 0.1 before rounding: Enslaved God +0.1 and Descendants +0.1 from the Claude Opus 4.7 launch (+0.06 each), with Reversion -0.1 (-0.06).
